policy: A skip or xfail reported at runtime fails the run. There is no allowed-skip list. The SQLite required run passes -m "not postgres" and the PostgreSQL required run passes no marker filter, with Docker Compose present so compose tests execute. Deselected test ids are committed here and checked against each run. Every collected test id passes in at least one required run.

sqlite.command: MOSS_USE_SQLITE=false MOSS_REQUIRED_RUN=sqlite uv run pytest -m "not postgres"
